name: githelm
description: Githelm — Tauri 2 + React 19 desktop client for self-hosted deployment

scripts.build:local: node scripts/generate-release-config.mjs && pnpm --filter @githelm/desktop exec tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.ci.conf.json --bundles app
scripts.build:dmg: node scripts/generate-release-config.mjs && pnpm --filter @githelm/desktop exec tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.ci.conf.json
scripts.lint:rust: pnpm --filter @githelm/desktop exec cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
